title: Report a Node.js below engines.node
goal: `nodes inspect` fails with the found and required versions when the target's Node.js is too old
acceptance: A committed test through nodesCommand fails before the fix
The required version is read from package.json engines.node, not repeated in code
The saved inspection format is unchanged
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no real host names.
escalation: Any write to a target goes to the owner first

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14: one version comparison and one regression. Not a measurement.
